units.rawText: Nascita and I will head outside to see what's going on. I'll leave this place to you.

units.rawText: How did the diagnostic go, Persicaria?

spans.text: How did the diagnostic go, Persicaria?

units.rawText: Professor... What's going to happen to Ranko?
units.displayText: Professor... What's going to happen to Ranko?

Nothing good, I'm afraid.

options.rawText: That'll depend on the Sanctifiers' decision.
options.displayText: That'll depend on the Sanctifiers' decision.

units.rawText: I know that, but... But she didn't do it entirely of her own will, right, Professor?
units.displayText: I know that, but... But she didn't do it entirely of her own will, right, Professor?

spans.text: I know that, but... But she didn't do it entirely of her own will, right, Professor?

units.rawText: She said "the Black Swan" gave her the flower, and that flower is the seed of the Entropy, right?

spans.text: She said "the Black Swan" gave her the flower, and that flower is the seed of the Entropy, right?

units.rawText: Maybe... Maybe she can hand off the blame...

spans.text: Maybe... Maybe she can hand off the blame...

units.rawText: Riko does her best to come up with reasons for Ranko to escape punishment, like a drowning man clutching at straws.

spans.text: Riko does her best to come up with reasons for Ranko to escape punishment, like a drowning man clutching at straws.

units.rawText: ...We may not be able to help.

units.displayText: What do you think, Eos?

units.displayText: She is silent and does not reply to me.

units.rawText: And we can bring everything that happened until now to a conclusion... Just being able to say that feels very surprising to me.

spans.text: And we can bring everything that happened until now to a conclusion... Just being able to say that feels very surprising to me.

units.rawText: Well, with the Prof's plans and us carrying it out, no matter how many dangers come, we'll be able to handle each and every one of them!
